rationale: Adapt the strongest remaining PR1612 signal conservatively by raising only QK gain from 1.5 to 2.0, leaving the already-better matrix LR and Muon warmup untouched. The prior 4.0/0.90 transplant overshot and broke the 16 MB cap; this keeps the attention-sharpening direction but reduces risk. I also removed the dormant final calibration path so code bytes drop and the artifact gets more headroom without changing the required training/eval prints.
title: Mild QK Gain With Leaner Endgame
